verdict.rationale: Base44 offers an SDK/CLI for CRUD on data entities, backend code/config management, and app MCP servers for external agents, giving strong programmatic access to backend/data operations. However, many UI-only capabilities (visual design board, theming/branding UI, AI-generated design previews, video generation, template publishing flow, login page customization) have no documented API/CLI equivalents, and there's no OpenAPI spec exposed (openapi probe returned 404s), suggesting API parity is partial rather than complete. missing for 10: documented API/CLI equivalents for visual design/branding tools, AI design preview workflow, media generation features, and a public OpenAPI spec confirming full UI-API parity.
